name: Goal24 Checkpoint 7 Lane A - Brain Approval Policy + Risk Enforcement + Plan Authorization Lifecycle

commits.message: feat(approval): add fail-closed risk approval policy
feat(approval): add server-owned plan authorization lifecycle
test(approval): bind grants to immutable plan semantics

approval_policy.approval_not_required_only_when: side_effect_class == read_only && risk_level == low && required_authority == L0

evidence_bridge: EvidenceEligibilityService.materializeEvidenceForExecutablePlan({ guard_run_id, capability_id, capability_version, normalized_inputs }) before plan authorization; forged coverage cannot enter CP7 (APPROVAL_EVIDENCE_INELIGIBLE)

approval_binding.digest_algorithm: canonical deterministic JSON (object keys stably sorted, array order preserved) + SHA-256 lowercase hex, reusing CP6 canonicalJson/sha256Hex primitives

actor_authority.schema: TrustedApprovalActorSchema (strict): actor_id, actor_kind owner|admin, authority_level L0..L3, source literal trusted_local

grant_verifier.lane_a_verifier: deterministic fakes in tests; Lane B wires the native authority

apply_approval_checks: grant expiry <= plan expiry / policy TTL cap

store.restart_semantics: restart invalidates pending/ready records; re-materialize and re-approve (fail closed); documented honestly, not persistent

expiry.plan_expiry: created_at + TTL bounded; caller expires_at may only shorten and must be > created_at
expiry.grant_expiry_bound: must not exceed min(plan expiry, policy TTL)
expiry.boundary: inclusive: now >= expires_at is expired (matches isExecutionPlanExpired)
expiry.clock: trusted injected clock; caller cannot submit now/granted_at/expires_at override as authority

approval_reference_wire.token_digest: now filled with the core-computed approval binding digest (CP2.1 deferred computation completed)

coverage: all five CP4 read capabilities stay approval-free
caller risk_snapshot / state / approval / plan_id / coverage rejected
bare ApprovalReference cannot ready; verified native grant can
wrong plan id / wrong binding digest rejected
L1 vs L2 rejected; L2 vs L2 accepted; L2 vs L3 rejected; L3 owner accepted
expired grant rejected; future granted_at rejected; grant past policy cap rejected
denied / revoked / expired can never ready
policy version mismatch (request, reference, runtime change) fails closed
input / coverage / risk / adapter / timeout / verification-plan / rollback-plan / decision / expiry mutations invalidate the binding digest
bounded store fail-closed; duplicate plan id conflict
expiry sweep transitions pending/grants to blocked
caller expires_at can shorten but never extend the policy bound

known_residual_risks: The grant verifier is injected Lane A; native approval validation is Lane B and approval UI is Checkpoint 9
The authorization store is memory-only: Brain restart invalidates pending/ready records (fail closed, documented, not persistent)
Plan expiry is uniformly bounded by the 15-minute V1 TTL; long-running approvals require an explicit future policy change
verification_plan / rollback_plan content correctness is verified at outcome-verification time (Checkpoint 8); mutations invalidate approvals via the binding digest
No production write capability exists yet; the write path is exercised with test-only capabilities
